svg.title: ARMOR-NETWORK architecture
svg.desc: ARMOR-NETWORK runs on a machine of the local network. It looks at the private network only (neighbour table, echoes, a few TCP ports, what the devices announce), keeps an inventory that tells what changed, watches the internet with an outage state machine and reports to ARMOR-SERVER, or by MQTT; Studio can hand it orders in the answer to its own message, and a login given for an inspection travels sealed for this node alone.
